claims.head: Bring popcorn
claims.call: The game’s pace score is above 103, faster than either team’s usual.

claims.body: The Penguins play some of the league’s fastest games, and so do the Capitals. We think this one runs hotter than either team’s usual.

claims.body: On the penalty kill, Pittsburgh is near the top of the league, but Washington is near the bottom. Penalties should hurt the Capitals more than the Penguins.

WSH.head: Close, but the Penguins have the slight edge
WSH.body: Even though Washington has home-ice advantage, Pittsburgh has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Capitals’ best way to tip it is getting good looks.

PIT.head: The Penguins start a half-step ahead
PIT.body: Even though Washington has home-ice advantage, Pittsburgh has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Capitals can still swing it if they get good looks.
